gen-press-start-2p-gf-tiny5: Press Start 2P spaces its blocky letters out like cut-outs, each one standing alone. Tiny5 follows with a clean, approachable sans whose ascenders look stubby, because the whole body runs so high.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-truculenta: Pixel-game fun, with a faint pinch in the strokes of Press Start 2P. Truculenta then packs its rounded, compact sans into a snug line, and that crowding is the quality you notice most.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-voces: Retro and playful, Press Start 2P puffs out its lowercase bowls like cartoon balloons. Voces stays measured beside it, a plain sans with lofty lowercase and stems barely thicker than its hairlines.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav sets modern, huddled letters with generous gaps at the terminals, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Press Start 2P then adds its retro, blocky punch up top, and the two sit comfortably on the page.
gen-press-start-2p-outfit: Press Start 2P brings a retro, playful grin, with bowls that look big and open. Outfit settles in below like cable bent into shapes, its curves stopping short of closing, so paragraphs glide along.
gen-righteous-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and loose, its curves lifted off the page before the loops close up. Righteous adds thin-rod bowls that fill the line above it.
gen-righteous-fs-synonym: Commanding yet playful, Righteous fills its line with big bowls. Synonym runs a plain sans stripe of constant ink beneath, and its generous curve openings keep a long stretch of text easy on the eye.
gen-righteous-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans keeps one stroke width through the entire alphabet, with short ascenders and a lofty x-height. Righteous is the showier one, bowls swelling to fill the line.
gen-righteous-gf-carlito: Thin steel rod, bent into bowls. Righteous makes a commanding display, while Carlito stays contemporary and tightly spaced, its small capitals sitting beside big lowercase.
gen-righteous-gf-changa: Changa gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, modern and clean. Righteous brings drafting-pen outlines of constant nib width, and the heading shows off while the body does the heavy lifting.
